specMs.why: SPEC.md budget: process launch to first usable content, median of 10. Populated workspaces require the editable page frame; an empty workspace reports its index screen. pnpm perf:cold enforces 500 ms on Apple Silicon, while CI gates its separately measured hosted budget. The maintainer accepted the current 10,001-page first-editable-frame result of 618 ms median on 2026-10-15 and deferred optimization. This value retains the 500 ms goal; the recorded local FAIL is not relabeled as a pass. Hosted CI budgets remain unchanged.

hostedCiMs.why: End-to-end budget on hosted macos-15. Three VMs of the same image measured series medians of 1449, 475, and 1634 ms with this harness, so the runner, not the app, sets the floor. 1.5 times the worst median, rounded up.

hostedNavToPaintMs.why: Empty-workspace index variant, navigation start to first content frame on hosted macos-15, the part the frontend controls. The same three VMs measured 242, 84, and 250 ms. 1.5 times the worst median, rounded up.

warmupRuns.why: The first launch of a fresh build pays signature checks and a cold page cache. Users see it once after brew upgrade, so it is logged and discarded.

timedRuns.why: SPEC: median of 10 runs. With an even count the median is the mean of the 5th and 6th sorted runs.

hostedPageNavToPaintMs.why: Seeded Getting started page navigation-to-paint variant on hosted macos-15. Calibration pending three hosted series on this fix round; 400 ms temporarily retains the old ceiling until those measurements finish. Orchestrator countersign pending.

p95Ms.why: The product goal remains 16 ms from the key event to the first frame showing the typed character. The maintainer allowed a small timing miss on 2026-10-15. This 19 ms ceiling accepts the measured immediate-source editor. Five alternating untraced rounds on the 5,000-block page read 18 ms and the quiet full-suite run read 19 ms. Every run kept 405 samples with exact character guards. Source updates stay inside the input event. The miss of 2 to 3 ms is explicit. These runs do not pass the original 16 ms goal. pnpm perf:keystroke enforces this ceiling on Apple Silicon.

hostedAppOwnedP95Ms.why: Provisional hosted macos-15 typing gate from unchanged 0ad6f34. Three fresh large-editor loads measured app-owned p95 of 31, 30 and 41 ms, pooled 33 ms; 45 ms rounds the worst load up by 4 ms. docs/evidence/data-5-ci-calibration-0ad6f34 records that method and the second attempt's fixture timeout. Recollection of CI runs created 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z through 2026-10-15T21:30:00Z across main and every PR branch, counting carried jobs once, spans 13 to 56 ms, median 34 ms. One of 44 large-editor jobs exceeds 45 ms, previously one of 43, about 2.3%. Job 116394063809 measured 56 ms on unchanged c4d2a7f; #86 later reported 47 ms outside the window. Keep 45 ms because ceil(1.5 * 56) = 84 ms would weaken sensitivity. At the median, an increase above 11 ms fails; the first whole-ms failure is 46 ms, +12 ms or 1.35x. docs/evidence/hosted-keystroke-calibration/README.md records the remaining false-failure risk; issue #87 tracks typing-specific calibration. The clock adds key-to-input and post-rAF rendering work, excluding layout before the stamp, scheduler and IPC delay, frame wait and presentation. Source delivery stays inside input. Local stays 19 ms with the 16 ms goal recorded; issue #72 retains complete presentation timing.

pageLoads.why: Three fresh page loads so one bad load cannot decide the verdict.

samplesPerLoad.why: 150 keys per load. With 15 discarded, 135 kept per load and 405 pooled for the p95.

discardedPerLoad.why: Frames right after a load are irregular. The first keys warm the page and are not counted.

gapMs.why: Keys 100 ms apart let the display link go idle between samples. Back-to-back keys measure vsync wait, not the app.

p95Ms.why: SPEC section 5: a query keystroke to the first frame showing current results over the 10,000-page mock fixture, one frame at 60 Hz.

hostedAppOwnedP50Ms.why: Hosted macos-15 palette p50 gate from CI runs created 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z through 2026-10-15T21:30:00Z across main and every PR branch, with carried jobs counted once. The 40 measured jobs ranged 12 to 22 ms, median 18 ms. ceil(1.5 * worst observed 22) = 33 ms. At that median, an increase above 15 ms fails; the first whole-ms failure is 34 ms, +16 ms or 1.89x. Palette p95 remains an 87 ms backstop because p50 cannot catch regressions confined to a few keys. docs/evidence/hosted-keystroke-calibration/README.md records the table and replay. The local p95 ceiling stays 16 ms. This recorder ends at the settled-frame task, not compositor presentation.

hostedAppOwnedP95Ms.why: Hosted macos-15 palette p95 backstop from CI runs created 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z through 2026-10-15T21:30:00Z across main and every PR branch, with carried jobs counted once. The 40 measured jobs ranged 25 to 58 ms, median 32 ms. ceil(1.5 * worst observed 58) = 87 ms. At that median, an increase above 55 ms fails; the first whole-ms failure is 88 ms, +56 ms or 2.75x. The separate 33 ms p50 gate detects steadier shifts. Identical 838f056 heads measured p95 29, 58 and 25 ms, unexplained hosted run-to-run variance. docs/evidence/hosted-keystroke-calibration/README.md records signed load associations without a causal load claim. The local ceiling stays 16 ms. The clock excludes compositor presentation; issue #72 retains that gap.

p95FrameMs.why: SPEC section 3 requires per-frame rendering work p95 under 16.7 ms. The untraced WebKit recorder measures its rAF timestamp to the following MessageChannel task. Whole-millisecond stamps must read at most 16 ms; the comparison is strict. Local mode gates this value and the unchanged 50 ms raw maximum. Hosted CI gates hostedWorkP95Ms and hostedMaxFrameMs. This clock excludes pending layout before the rAF timestamp, scheduler and IPC delay, and presentation.

hostedWorkP95Ms.why: Hosted macos-15 scroll rendering-work p95 gate from CI runs created 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z through 2026-10-15T21:30:00Z across main and every PR branch, with carried jobs counted once. The 40 measured jobs ranged 9 to 23 ms, median 15 ms. ceil(1.5 * worst observed 23) = 35 ms. At that median, an increase above 20 ms fails; the first whole-ms failure is 36 ms, +21 ms or 2.40x. docs/evidence/hosted-keystroke-calibration/README.md records the table and replay. The 83 ms rAF interval maximum is a backstop. Work max is information, so isolated long work can still pass. The local work-p95 gate stays strictly below 16.7 ms and the local interval maximum stays 50 ms. This clock omits work before the rAF timestamp and presentation.

maxFrameMs.why: SPEC editor fixture: no frame gap over 50 ms while scrolling the 5,000-block page. Local mode enforces this unchanged maximum. Hosted CI uses hostedMaxFrameMs.

hostedMaxFrameMs.why: Hosted macos-15 rAF timestamp-spacing backstop from CI runs created 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z through 2026-10-15T21:30:00Z across main and every PR branch, with carried jobs counted once. The 40 measured jobs ranged 20 to 55 ms, median 33.5 ms. ceil(1.5 * worst observed 55) = 83 ms. At that median, an increase above 49.5 ms fails; the first whole-ms failure is 84 ms, +50.5 ms or 2.51x. The separate 35 ms work-p95 gate detects steadier shifts. This maximum bounds timestamp spacing, not all work or presentation stalls. Job 116673405096 measured work max 115 ms with a 55 ms interval and would pass these gates. docs/evidence/hosted-keystroke-calibration/README.md links that job and records the replay. The local interval maximum stays 50 ms. Existing logs count over-33 ms intervals but cannot calibrate an exact over-50 ms allowance.

p95Ms.why: SPEC section 5: the complete Rust content query must stay below 5 ms p95 on the 10,000-page fixture. The release gate includes broad prefixes, common words, winner highlights, cold readers, both result limits and the additional 5,000-block page.

hostedP95Ms.why: Provisional hosted macos-15 calibration from two unchanged-head 0ad6f34 release jobs. Each ran all 192 complete-query cases with 30 fresh-reader and 200 steady queries per case. Their worst fresh-reader p95 values were 27.137709 and 30.837625 ms; their worst steady p95 values were 5.006167 and 8.418250 ms. This ceiling rounds the worse measured fresh-reader p95 up to the next 5 ms. Three-core host load ranged from 10.07 to 31.03. docs/evidence/data-5-ci-calibration-0ad6f34 summarizes the limits and links the full logs at the commit before the evidence trim. The local product query gate remains 5 ms and all result-consumption and correctness assertions remain required. Issue #72 tracks broader hosted calibration.

firstSamples.why: Thirty fresh-reader queries per bucket, with open, statement preparation and tokenizer creation inside the clock. The Rust gate also runs 200 steady queries and refuses fewer than 30 first-query samples.

maxLoadPerCore.why: 1-minute load average per CPU core above which a run is labelled NOISY. CI's quiet-machine wait releases below a load of 2.5 on the 3-core macos-15 runner, which is 0.83 per core, so 0.8 is the same bar rounded down. The label is information: it never changes a verdict or an exit code, and nothing waits for the load to fall.
